description: Expectations of the word-proxy steps (test/word-proxy/ci.sh), checked by verify.mjs and compare.mjs. "_all" applies to every step. knownBug marks an expectation that documents a product bug: the PR that fixes it flips the expectation (H-W1 was flipped when the product started writing ZOTERO_PREF_*).

_all.why: H-W2: no 'citation changed' alert, noteIndex written by Zotero (0); H-W3: one item id per URI, no duplicate bibliography entries; one bibliography field with every corpus item; nothing in footnotes

apa.why: H-W1 fixed: the product writes ZOTERO_PREF_* (style of the injection, fieldType Field): no Document Preferences dialog on the first Refresh, the injected style is applied; H-W4: a locator without label renders as a page; H-W5: items not in the library come from the embedded itemData, without requests
visibleIncludes: (Peroni, Campoy, et al., 2023; Peroni, Hufnagl, et al., 2023)
bibliographyIncludes: In J. Edmond (Ed.), Digital Technology and the Practices of Humanities Research (pp. 105–122)

vancouver.why: NLM citation-sequence prints no locator in the citation

proposed.why: before the H-W1 fix the first Refresh opened Document Preferences and accepting the proposal turned the citations into note text; now there is nothing to accept: no dialog, the injected style (apa) is applied

again.why: second Refresh of a document Zotero already refreshed (≈W-08): no dialog, same text, items already known to the session

restyle.why: Document Preferences opened on purpose (≈W-05), style changed to chicago-author-date

group.why: H-W5: group 777 is not in the local Zotero: embedded itemData, no request

lib-apa.why: path A: the same items in the local user library (URI users/<any id> → local user library): library data, no dialog

lib-group.why: H-W5: group 777 present locally → library items

ab.why: bibliography from the library (lib-apa) against the one from the product's embedded itemData (apa): no difference expected since zoteroItemToCsl maps university, institution, repository/archiveID, the genre, accessDate, ISBN, ISSN, edition, language and the number of pages
